correctness.rationale: For every finite simple graph orientation and finite field, matrix formula [a,b]_e=(d_u-d_v)y_e-x_e(h_u-h_v) is exact. For fixed equal-color flat Z, free y outside Z produce m-|Z| independent image coordinates and surviving x-weighted incidence rows on Z have rank r_G(S), including characteristic two. The flat-chromatic and support partition is exhaustive. The characteristic polynomial under matroid contraction proves normalized invariance; cycle-nullity proves vertex arboricity. Forest binomial follows edgewise. The actual embedded verifier independently checks rank matrices and every commuting pair in bounded finite cases and returns VERIFY_OK; only the proof establishes arbitrary fields and graphs.

value.rationale: This is a complete natural adjoint-rank invariant across every oriented simple graph quiver over all finite fields, not an isolated numerical improvement. It produces a matroid invariance not apparent in quiver orientation and a sharp equivalence between surjectivity of one inner commutator and a classical nontrivial vertex arboricity parameter. The full forest law and sharp K5 characteristic-two obstruction demonstrate meaningful graph-dependent information.
